sources.title: AI CodeFix | AC/DC | Sonar Documentation
sources.snippet: Overview AI CodeFix solves issues in the code maintenance loop of the Agent Centric Development Cycle. Sonar's AI CodeFix uses a large language model (LLM) to automatically generate AI-driven code fixes for the issues discovered by SonarQube Cloud or SonarQube Server.
